notes.subject: שובה/משבה
notes.rationale: Poelelo ya go boela: šubah (boela!) le mešubah (go boela morago) — modu o tee o fetoga sephekgo, se se laolwago ke phetolelo.

notes.subject: אפיל פני
notes.rationale: Sefahlego sa go wa — go phuntsa sefahlego; kgetollo ya Sesotho ke 'go tletša mašufa', se se latofatšago sefahlego.

notes.subject: אטור
notes.rationale: Go swara/go boloka — go boloka narara; e boditšwe 'go swara narara' ka gobane Lentšu le bolokang dilo.

notes.subject: חסיד
notes.rationale: Wa hesede (wa mohau) kgahlanong le 'halalelwa' kapa 'wa mohau' — mantšu a mantši a KJV 'merciful', JPS 'merciful'.

notes.subject: to Yisraele
notes.rationale: Boledišo bjo bo ela boretša go Yisraele wa leboa — pitšo ya go boela morago.

notes.subject: שובה
notes.rationale: Pitšo ya go boela morago — taello ya sephiri go setšhaba se se tlwaeditšego.

translation: Eya, o tsebitše ⟨את⟩ mantšu a se a leboa, gomme o re: Boela, o wa go boela morago, Yisraele, go bolela Yahwe; ga ke na go phuntsa ⟨את⟩ sefahlego sa ka go lena, ka gobane ke wa hesede, go bolela Yahwe; ga ke na go swara narara ka narara-nako e moka.
